change_summary: Replaced the single K-reduction loop containing a dynamic `if k_remaining < BLOCK_K` branch with two separate sections: a branch-free main loop over full K-blocks (`for k in range(0, K // BLOCK_K)`) with unmasked loads only, followed by an optional tail block with masked loads only when `K % BLOCK_K != 0`, enabling FMA fusion by giving the compiler a statically-uniform loop body.
